fixture.producer: isolated fixture COM wrappers observing application Lock/Unlock writes; not the proxy trace
fixture.usage: D3DUSAGE_WRITEONLY for both VB and IB

result.comparison: Reference D3D8, D3D8 with proxy, and synthetic DX12 replay PPM streams matched byte for byte.

limitations: Fixture wrappers are not integrated into the TDS proxy or a complete device wrapper.
The snapshot comes from fixture wrappers observing application write locks, not from proxy trace data.
Native GetDevice/unknown interfaces and duplicate adoption can escape or break COM identity; state blocks and global device alias invalidation are not covered.
One controlled, serial indexed triangle is tested; indexed vertices are expanded to an unindexed UP replay packet.
This Wine translation-layer test does not establish native Windows, TDS, gameplay, PBR or stealth correctness.
